install-helpdesk.the-helpdesk: The Helpdesk plugin is available in your Essential plan.

getting-started-knowledge.title: Getting Started With Your Knowledge Base
getting-started-knowledge.step-description: You are few steps away from using your Knowledge Base.
getting-started-knowledge.locate-description: OnlyChat Knowledge Base is fully multilingual. Get started by configuring your default Knowledge Base locale.
getting-started-knowledge.import-description: Using another Knowledge Base provider? No problem! You can import all articles from your previous provider in a single click.
getting-started-knowledge.create-your-first-article: Create your first article. Write a first draft, preview it, and publish it.

add-a-language.add-language-title: Add A Language To Your Knowledge Base
add-a-language.add-language-description: Your Knowledge Base can be multilingual, and requires at least one locale.

import-articles.onlychat-with-automatically: OnlyChat with automatically configure and adjust articles from your previous Knowledge Base. Submit previous Knowledge Base URL and start the import.
import-articles.import-description: Using another Knowledge Base provider? No problem! You can import all articles from your previous provider in a single click.

export-articles.title: Export Knowledge Base Articles
export-articles.description: It will take a few minutes. You will get an email when the export is over.
